entities.summary: Sitakot Vihara is an archaeological site located in Nawabganj Upazila in Dinajpur district of Bangladesh. Through regular excavations in the years 1968 and 1972–1973, an ancient Buddhist monastery was discovered at the site. The monastery dates from a similar time period to the nearby Somapura Mahavihara and Halud Vihara.
